source_review: Five encoded GFNI columns and eleven original LUT rows cover all sixteen contributions exactly.
Raw first inverse round cancels the inverse S-box in the remaining LUT rows via Pi indices.
Round-key seeds are included once; register constraints and row offsets preserve alignment and bounds.
Final inverse substitution uses @shuffle with a zero second vector: all 64 index lanes are defined.
LLVM, architecture, GFNI, AVX-512 F/BW/VBMI, EVEX512, AVX2 and VL gates protect the hybrid dispatch.
Public block/key aliases and Cipher fields are unchanged; empty/single bulk paths guard accesses.
